subject.title: fix(channels): Slack stops receiving messages while reporting healthy when its plugin is not a trusted install

question: Should all channel plugins sharing this monitor treat a denied durable ingress queue as a hard startup failure, rather than expose a connected-but-nonfunctional channel state?
rationale: The code path is shared across channel plugins and deliberately changes the operator-visible lifecycle for improperly installed external plugins; the repository’s compatibility guidance calls for explicit review of startup and fallback behavior.

options.title: Approve fail-fast startup
options.body: Keep the existing trust boundary and make queue denial fail startup with the improved remediation message.

options.title: Require an explicit degraded state
options.body: Retain startup but add a distinct unhealthy status and suppress ingress polling only if maintainers want a nonfunctional channel to remain inspectable.

recommendation.title: Approve fail-fast startup
recommendation.body: Keep the existing trust boundary and make queue denial fail startup with the improved remediation message.

likelyOwner.reason: The current branch and production diagnosis define the affected monitor and trust-gate interaction, though broader history ownership remains unconfirmed.
